subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: May `agents_list` expose operator-authored descriptions for agents already visible under `subagents.allowAgents`, and what maximum length should be enforced?
rationale: The implementation and live proof are clear, but the change makes configured text agent-visible and the linked PR discussion explicitly reserves that visibility boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Approve bounded exposure
options.body: Return trimmed nonblank descriptions for existing allowed targets with an explicit maximum length.

options.title: Keep descriptions operator-only
options.body: Retain the config field but document that `agents_list` intentionally excludes authored text.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded exposure
recommendation.body: Return trimmed nonblank descriptions for existing allowed targets with an explicit maximum length.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `agents_list` and has the strongest current-main provenance across the affected tool and config surfaces.
